audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] said 'Windwall his Relentless Pursuit', and nothing on the page mentioned that your own knockup arms his passive.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is a dash — no projectile, so Wind Wall does nothing to it. His projectiles are Piercing Light (Q), Ardent Blaze (W) and The Culling (R). Separately, Riot's Lightslinger text says his next two attacks deal bonus magic damage 'when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized' — your Steel Tempest knockup satisfies that condition, so landing it hands him a damage buff on the follow-up.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall answers Q, W and R; E is a dash it cannot touch. Your knockup immobilizes and empowers his next two autos.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 6 gave the stage to Yasuo or called it even.
audit.why: The mirror flipped levels 1, 2, 3 and 6 to Lucian, keeping 4-5 as Skill and both item rows for Yasuo. A 500-range Q on 9s plus the double-shot passive beats a 475-range melee for the whole early game, and The Culling at 6 is a bigger swing than Last Breath into a champion with a dash.
audit.corrected: Rows: Lucian, Lucian, Lucian, Skill, Lucian, Yasuo, Yasuo — matched full/content pairs with ratings moved to fit.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice; every line said 'when it is down' without a number.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 but Lightslinger attacks shorten it, so the user should be counting his autos rather than a timer. Piercing Light is 9s at rank 1 and The Culling is 110s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, phases[2].why and phases[4].why.

notes: Best find here: Lightslinger's second clause — 'when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage' — means your Steel Tempest knockup ARMS his passive. Every Yasuo page tells you to land the knockup; against Lucian it comes with a cost, and that had never been stated. Two flags in the data are misfires I did not write from: the needs-antiheal rule fires on Lightslinger, but Riot's text says only that Lucian is 'healed or shielded by an ally' — he has no self-heal, so Grievous Wounds is not indicated here. packet.suspectNames flagged 'Use Relentless Pursuit' in wants.foe[1] — FALSE POSITIVE, that is his real E name. Whether Wind Wall dropped mid-channel stops an already-firing Culling is not in Riot's text, so the text says only that a wall held before he opens blanks it.
